function.name: narra_now
function.description: Live metas (clusters of token launches) on Pons v2 / Robinhood Chain with status HOT, EMERGING, ROTATING IN/OUT, COOLING or DEAD, launches, ETH in, buyers, graduations and flow arrows. Implement by running `narra now --json` with the given flags.

function.name: narra_coin
function.description: Verdict for a Pons v2 contract address: IN, EDGE, OUT, ORPHAN or NOT_PONS with cluster, membership score, reasons and watch-outs. Call first whenever the user pastes a 0x address. Implement by running `narra coin <address> --json`.

function.name: narra_flow
function.description: Edges A→B of repeat buyers and deployers moving between metas. Implement by running `narra flow --json`.

function.name: narra_why
function.description: Why a meta is named and grouped that way: tags with example tickers, members, links, flow. Implement by running `narra why <slug> --json`.
